paper.title: Closing the EFC Consciousness Bridge: Dimensionless, Scale-Invariant Unification of Entropy, Dynamics, and Awareness
paper.author: Morten Magnusson

domain.scope: Cross-domain unification of cosmological entropy field S with cognitive observables (Omega, kappa)

three_problems_resolved.problem: C = Omega * kappa is a separable product; coupling is external, not intrinsic
three_problems_resolved.resolution: Non-separable functional C = Omega_hat * kappa_hat * (1 - exp(-gamma * Omega_hat * kappa_hat))

three_problems_resolved.problem: No dynamical equation for Omega_dot or kappa_dot
three_problems_resolved.resolution: Coupled ODEs: Eq. I (entropic drift + diffusion) and Eq. II (energy-flow source + suppression)

three_problems_resolved.problem: Variables not dimensionally connected to cosmological entropy field S
three_problems_resolved.resolution: Regime-indexed dimensionless variables Omega_hat_l = S(rho)/S_l and kappa_hat_l = (alpha_l/rho_l)|grad(delta S/delta rho)|

cross_domain_constant_K.source: SPARC galactic rotation curve data via B1* bridge equation (EFC-C v2)
cross_domain_constant_K.lambda_2_W: Fiedler eigenvalue of connectivity matrix W

efc_mechanisms.entropy_field: S(rho) from EFC field equation G_mu_nu + Lambda g_mu_nu = kappa_G T_mu_nu + alpha S_mu_nu
efc_mechanisms.causal_integration: kappa = <T(X -> Y)> (mean transfer entropy between subsystem pairs)
efc_mechanisms.non_separable_coupling: gamma > 0 is the single new coupling constant; exponential factor prevents factorisation
efc_mechanisms.anti_correlation_mechanism: At steady state, kappa_hat_ss = J_flow / (mu * Omega_hat) ~ 1/Omega_hat; derived, not imposed

propofol_sedation_support.external_dataset: Chennu et al. 2016, PLoS Comput. Biol. 12(1), e1004669
propofol_sedation_support.caveat: Qualitative structure consistent; not a direct test of full model (requires grad(delta S/delta rho) estimation)
